slides.title:
A branch build
should take two days.
Where the two weeks go
slides.body:
Addressing requested, then waited on.
"Which switch is standard
 this quarter?" — *two answers*.

slides.title: A config copied from a copy
slides.body:
Which was copied from the one
before it, carrying a typo through
*four buildings*.

slides.title: One template
slides.body:
Parameterized. Fill in values —
don't copy and edit.

slides.title: One addressing scheme
slides.body:
Allocated from a system that
records who holds what.
Not a *spreadsheet*.

slides.title: One staging step
slides.body:
Configured, powered and validated
*before it ships* — not in a closet
on speakerphone.

slides.title: One acceptance test
slides.body:
Written down. Including one that
proves traffic takes the path
you *intended*.

slides.title: Four decisions made once.
slides.body:
Not renegotiated at every site.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
